name: create_scheduled_task
description: Create a durable scheduled automation that runs a prompt for the user on a cadence (once/daily/weekly/monthly). USE when the user asks to schedule, automate, remind, or run something every day/week/month, or when they arrived via 'Create via chat' for scheduled tasks. Gather name, requirement (what to do each run), frequency, local time HH:MM, timezone (IANA), and optional expiration YYYY-MM-DD before calling. For weekly require day_of_week (0=Sun..6=Sat). For monthly require day_of_month (1–31). For once require run_date YYYY-MM-DD. After success, confirm the schedule and next run in plain language. Link them to Scheduled Tasks in the sidebar if helpful. DO NOT invent times — ask if missing. Prefer the user's stated timezone; otherwise ask for it. Pass null for fields that do not apply.

requirement.description: Full instruction Clauxen should execute on each run (the prompt).

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata or America/New_York.

run_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD — required when frequency is once.

expires_at.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD — stop scheduling after this calendar day. Pass null if none.
